Upgrades the Docker build and production runtime from end-of-life Node 20 to Node.js 24.22.2. This includes the Brotli decoder security fix for CVE-2026-111497 first released in Node 24.22.1, plus the subsequent Node 24 patch fixes. Addresses #39 via #42.

- Aligns CI and local development with Node 24.22.2 using `.nvmrc`.
- Publishes Linux amd64 and arm64 images after unit tests, production builds, container API tests, scheduler initialization, and exact runtime-version checks.
- Updates Docker Hub tags `3.2.12`, `latest`, and `stable` in `dh1011/subscription-manager`.

Validation of the runtime upgrade included 21 unit tests, TypeScript checks, 12 production-container API tests, and 26 passing Chromium GUI scenarios. Three existing GUI behaviors remain unchanged: currency-name search fails, importing into a populated list hides existing entries until reload, and repeated imports append duplicates. GUI testing used synthetic data and local notification stubs; external fonts/icons and other browsers were not fully verified.

No application feature, UI, or database-schema changes are included. App-specific exploitability of the Node vulnerability was not established.

Pull `dh1011/subscription-manager:3.2.12` (or `latest` / `stable`) and recreate the container while retaining the existing data volume.

References: [Node security advisory](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability/october-2026-security-releases), [Node 24.22.2 release](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v24.22.2).
